description: This file defines the UserSettingsImplementation class, which implements user settings management, notification handling, and configuration interfaces for a media or user profile system. It includes class definitions, method declarations, constants, and internal notification mechanisms.

classes.name: UserSettingsImplementation
classes.description: Implements user settings management, notification handling, and configuration for a media application, supporting various user preferences and event notifications.

classes.name: Store2Notification
classes.description: Internal class that handles notifications from the IStore2 interface, forwarding value changes to the parent UserSettingsImplementation.

classes.name: Job
classes.description: Represents a dispatched task for handling user setting events asynchronously.

methods.name: Register
methods.description: Registers a notification callback for user setting changes.

methods.name: Unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a previously registered notification callback.

methods.name: SetAudioDescription
methods.description: Enables or disables audio description setting.

methods.name: GetAudioDescription
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of audio description setting.

methods.name: SetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Sets the preferred closed captioning service.

methods.name: GetPreferredClosedCaptionService
methods.description: Retrieves the preferred closed captioning service.

methods.name: SetLiveWatershed
methods.description: Enables or disables live watershed setting.

methods.name: SetPlaybackWatershed
methods.description: Enables or disables playback watershed setting.

methods.name: SetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Sets blocking of not rated content.

methods.name: GetBlockNotRatedContent
methods.description: Gets the block not rated content setting.

methods.name: SetPinOnPurchase
methods.description: Enables or disables PIN requirement on purchase.

methods.name: GetPinOnPurchase
methods.description: Retrieves the PIN on purchase setting.

methods.name: SetHighContrast
methods.description: Enables or disables high contrast mode.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidanceRate
methods.description: Sets the rate of voice guidance.

methods.name: SetVoiceGuidanceHints
methods.description: Enables or disables voice guidance hints.

methods.name: GetMigrationState
methods.description: Checks if a specific setting requires migration.

methods.name: GetMigrationStates
methods.description: Retrieves migration states for all settings.

methods.name: Configure
methods.description: Configures the plugin with the host service.

methods.name: ValueChanged
methods.description: Handles value change notifications from the store.
